basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate mycologist based in the beautiful Pacific Northwest. I've been fascinated by fungi ever since I stumbled upon a field guide in my local library as a child. When I'm not out in the woods foraging for mushrooms or cultivating my own at home, I'm usually diving into the latest supernatural lore or tinkering with my GNOME desktop environment. By trade, I'm an environmental scientist, a role that lets me blend my love for the outdoors with my scientific curiosity. I'm happily married to my college sweetheart, and we often embark on weekend hikes together. My typical online hours are in the evenings, usually post-dinner, as I find it a great way to unwind.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in mycology stems from both formal education with a degree in Environmental Science and a decade of self-directed study. I've attended numerous workshops and conferences to stay updated on the latest research and techniques in fungi cultivation. Additionally, my professional experience as an environmental scientist enriches my understanding of ecosystems and biodiversity.
